dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: "The grass did spring and sprout anew, and heaven and earth both verdant grew"...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After the rain, the wind blows gently and the clouds are light. Looking out over the horizon, one's heart is opened wide.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And then, should one happen to meet an old friend... Well, there could be no better day than this, wouldn't you agree?
